title: Oozy Argentinian Egg Frittata
description: A funky Argentinian dish featuring eggs, cheese, and a dash of friendly ingredients, perfect for a brunch mood. This recipe combines the richness of eggs and cheese with the simplicity of a frittata.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper and cook until they are softened.
Add the chopped ham and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shredded provolone and grated parmesan cheese to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked ham and vegetables in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
